title: Samsung TL A50 — Manual check mode
description: Manual Smart Install — press Spin to advance component tests.

source.manualTitle: Samsung Top-Load Washer A50 Family (WA50R, WA51DG, WF45A)

steps.title: Enter manual check
steps.body: From AS: press Spin. Spin advances: 1 door lock, 2 drain, 3 prep valve, Co cold, Ho hot, 6 water shot/heater/rinse, 7 drain, 8 spin, 9 dry heater/fan, 10 door.
